description:
HushThreads v0.0.13 has 19 patches for Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (com.instagram.barcelona).

Two patches are new. Hide the Instagram button takes the Instagram button off profiles, and Hide ghost post bubbles takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures. Both switches are on the Appearance page under More settings and start off. Threads' push process now closes each time Android stops its service, so it no longer piles up threads when you come back to the app. Manager's default selection holds every patch but Change version code, Remove share targets and Trust user-added certificates, and the five patches that joined it start with their switches off. This release patches Threads 450 only.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 832 runtime tests passed locally. All 245 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 19 patches applied to Threads 450.0.0.51.78 without forcing, and the release receipt records the run.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (version code 512008342). The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
